public_definitions: The goal is to review the 2005-2014 temperature record and choose the handling route based on whether the period-wide change is large enough to require targeted follow-up or ordinary enough to remain on routine monitoring.
The chart reference is the dashboard record, which is the evidence source for deciding whether the period-wide temperature change warrants targeted follow-up.
The primary field label is 'Temperature change handling route'.

The options are: 'Route the 2005-2014 temperature change to substantial-change follow-up', 'Keep the 2005-2014 temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation', 'Route the temperature record to archive and background filing'.

The page instructions are: 'Review the 2005-2014 temperature record and choose the handling route based on whether the period-wide change is large enough to require targeted follow-up or ordinary enough to remain on routine monitoring.', 'Use the dashboard record as the evidence source for deciding whether the period-wide temperature change warrants targeted follow-up.'
